content: Yazdī collection item 5: from Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī (?) to Ibn Turka, a petition to his teacher referring to one of his sons (makhdūm-zāda) (YMN/V ff. 165b-66b, YMN/MS p. 235). Item 6: a letter of condolence (taʿziyat-nāma) to Ibn Turka's children on their father's death (YMN/V ff. 166b-67b, YMN/MS pp. 235-36).
